name: Margie
bio: Fights with a polearm and shotgun, focused on skill damage and crowd control.

skills.name: Margie's Treasure Shovel
skills.desc: Attack enemies in front, dealing Pyro Damage and stunning them. When using this skill by long press, Margie makes a continuous attack.

skills.name: Margie's Combustible Bin
skills.desc: Casts 3 [Margie's Combustible Bins] forward. They immediately explode upon hitting any target, dealing AoE Pyro Damage and consuming a certain stacks of [Jackpot!] for enhancement: When consuming 3 stacks of [Jackpot!]: Increases the explosion range and damage. When consuming 6 stacks of [Jackpot!]: Creates a Zealous Zone after the explosion, dealing Pyro Damage once every 2s to enemies within the zone. When consuming 9 stacks of [Jackpot!]: Deals additional AoE Pyro Damage 2 times after the explosion.

skills.name: Margie's Recycling Sack
skills.desc: When Margie or her nearby teammate(s) pick up any loot, Margie gains 1 stack of [Jackpot!] that lasts throughout the battle. Each stack increases Margie's Skill Damage, up to 20 stacks.

skills.name: Margie's Pep Song
skills.desc: Increases the ATK of nearby teammate(s).

skills.name: Strike
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby teammate(s).
